+def load_feature_flags() -> dict:
+    """Load feature flags from configs/feature_flags.yaml.
+
+    Returns an empty dict when the file is missing or unreadable.
+    """
+    path = config_path("feature_flags.yaml")
+    if not path.exists():
+        return {}
+    return _parse_simple_yaml(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def _parse_simple_yaml(text: str) -> dict:
+    """Parse the small, flat two-level YAML used by feature_flags.yaml.
+
+    Supports sections with scalar key/value pairs, e.g.:
+
+        notifications:
+          email_dispatch_enabled: false
+    """
+    result: dict = {}
+    current_section: str | None = None
+    for raw_line in text.splitlines():
+        line = raw_line.rstrip()
+        if not line.strip() or line.strip().startswith("#"):
+            continue
+        if not line.startswith((" ", "\t")):
+            # Top-level section header.
+            current_section = line.rstrip(":").strip()
+            result.setdefault(current_section, {})
+            continue
+        if current_section is None:
+            continue
+        key, _, value = line.strip().partition(":")
+        key = key.strip()
+        value = value.strip()
+        if not key:
+            continue
+        result[current_section][key] = _parse_scalar(value)
+    return result
+
+
+def _parse_scalar(value: str):
+    if value == "true":
+        return True
+    if value == "false":
+        return False
+    return value
